reason: I call everyone back in the evening anyway, so I don't believe I'm losing jobs. 99 euros every month is almost 1,200 a year for something I already do myself at no cost.
objection: A monthly fee that never stops, from a brand-new company with no customers, for a problem I don't think I have. And I don't want strangers sending WhatsApps in my name.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 14-day check showed me in black and white that several callers never rang back and those were real jobs worth more than the fee, I'd think about it, but at a lower price.
